# Applications

- [CalCOFI Schema](https://calcofi.io/db-schema/)\
  per-release schema browser: ERD, tables, columns (with units + descriptions), datasets, measurement-type registry — sourced from the release `metadata.json` sidecar on GCS
- [CalCOFI Query](https://calcofi.io/db-query/)\
  browser-only DuckDB-WASM playground against the public release Parquet on GCS
- [CalCOFI Explorer](https://calcofi.io/explore/)\
  one app, six lenses — stations, hexagons, contours, cruises, regions and sections — over the frozen release, in the browser
- [UCSB Student Capstone](https://app.calcofi.io/capstone/) (archived)
